name: The net maps' own pieces on generated layers
now: Surveyed over 24 areas (issue #505). On layers: CopyBot Comp's claws, BN4's Undernet's flames and the Undernet's and Undernet Zero's fire bowls, cut from the maps' second tile layer with the panel they grip and the panels they draw over (src/map/sides.c), MegaMan drawn behind them as in BN6, and the Underground's teal emblems. The Undernet's bowls are tile animations the maps' GFXAnim lists write (tiles 726-737; tools/map_anims.py) and burn on a generated layer by the game's own script; Aquarium Comp's fish (tiles 1-12) are found and not set.
left: The Aquarium's pillars with their fish (its pads are raised floor in its maps) and Robot Control's pipes; the other kinds on issue #505.
